script_text: Something's truly stirring in your Venus-ruled Earth world that you won't see coming. Monday and Tuesday, Mars squares Venus from Aries, creating tension in your 2nd House of money and possessions—expect arguments over bills or shared resources. You'll feel the pinch as your stubborn Taurean nature clashes with sudden expenses. Wednesday, Venus enters your 5th House, making it your power day for romance and creative wins—act boldly. Thursday, the Sun conjuncts Neptune in your 8th House, forcing a very deeply spiritual reckoning around shared money and debt. By Friday, Mars opposition Saturn in Pisces destabilizes career plans—your worst day, so avoid big decisions and impulsive spending. Weekend brings a deeply calm as Venus trines Mercury, easing communication with partners and lifting your mood. Best day: Wednesday. Worst day: Friday.
